svg.title: The predeclared mode-one establishment gate fails
svg.desc: Fine uniform P1 FEM and independent conservative FD mode-one amplitude and modal fraction. Both simultaneous requirements must persist for 50 time units, while the longest run on the one-unit record grid is 16 units.
